build_deepsets_model: build a Deepsets model with configurable local and global MLPs for set aggregation
create_deepsets_config: create a DeepsetsConfig dataclass to configure aggregation strategy and MLP layer sizes
test_reduce_aggregation: test the _DeepsetsNet reduce method with sum, mean, max, min, or mul aggregation
review_deepsets_forward: review the Deepsets forward pass that processes set and tensor inputs through local and global networks
refactor_deepsets_net: refactor the _DeepsetsNet forward method to apply local_nn, reduce, and global_nn in sequence
